<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <g id="background-image">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="290" fill="#143CC9"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="290" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
    <path d="M0 0 L92 0 L145 290 L0 290 Z" fill="#000000" opacity="0.22"/>
    <path d="M390 0 L298 0 L245 290 L390 290 Z" fill="#000000" opacity="0.22"/>
    <path d="M0 235 Q195 188 390 235 L390 290 L0 290 Z" fill="#000000" opacity="0.38"/>

    <rect x="86" y="84" width="218" height="102" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <polygon points="108,167 154,117 184,145 209,128 282,167" fill="#143CC9"/>
    <circle cx="246" cy="111" r="15" fill="#E0E0E0"/>
    <line x1="74" y1="204" x2="316" y2="204" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="5"/>
  </g>

  <g id="status-bar">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="34" fill="#000000" opacity="0.25"/>
    <text x="20" y="22" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <line x1="335" y1="17" x2="341" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="14" x2="344" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="348" y1="11" x2="348" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="352" y1="8" x2="352" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="316" cy="15" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="316" y1="15" x2="322" y2="9" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="9" width="21" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="385" y="13" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="365" y="11" width="15" height="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <g id="header">
    <rect x="18" y="52" width="30" height="29" rx="15" fill="#000000"/>
    <polyline points="36,61 29,66 36,72" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="64" y="71" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Payment</text>
  </g>

  <g id="prompt-card">
    <rect x="36" y="226" width="318" height="3" rx="2" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="36" y="220" width="318" height="428" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.16"/>
    <rect x="36" y="216" width="318" height="428" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <circle cx="195" cy="267" r="32" fill="#143CC9"/>
    <rect x="181" y="252" width="28" height="20" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="181" y1="258" x2="209" y2="258" stroke="#143CC9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="187" cy="267" r="2" fill="#143CC9"/>
    <circle cx="202" cy="267" r="2" fill="#143CC9"/>
    
    <text x="195" y="334" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Save payment information?</text>
    <text x="195" y="372" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Would you like to securely save your</text>
    <text x="195" y="394" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">payment details for future purchases?</text>
    
    <rect x="70" y="428" width="250" height="62" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.16"/>
    <g id="yes-button">
      <rect x="70" y="424" width="250" height="62" rx="13" fill="#E0E0E0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="195" y="463" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="23px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">YES</text>
    </g>
    
    <g id="no-button">
      <rect x="147" y="520" width="96" height="36" rx="13" fill="#E0E0E0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="195" y="544" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">NO</text>
    </g>
    
    <line x1="70" y1="584" x2="320" y2="584" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="610" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#747474">Your information stays private and secure.</text>
  </g>

  <g id="purchase-summary">
    <text x="24" y="687" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">CURRENT PURCHASE</text>
    <line x1="24" y1="699" x2="366" y2="699" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="24" y="724" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">THOR: LOVE AND THUNDER</text>
    <text x="24" y="744" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#747474">Today · 7:30 PM · Seats C12, C13</text>
    <text x="366" y="733" text-anchor="end" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">$28.00</text>
  </g>

  <g id="navigation-bar">
    <rect x="0" y="770" width="390" height="74" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="770" x2="390" y2="770" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <g id="home-tab">
      <polygon points="38,798 48,789 58,798 58,809 38,809" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <polygon points="36,798 48,787 60,798 58,800 48,791 38,800" fill="#000000"/>
      <text x="48" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Home</text>
    </g>
    
    <g id="movies-tab">
      <rect x="116" y="790" width="25" height="18" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="121" y1="790" x2="121" y2="808" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
      <line x1="136" y1="790" x2="136" y2="808" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="128" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Movies</text>
    </g>
    
    <g id="tickets-tab">
      <rect x="194" y="791" width="26" height="17" rx="2" fill="#143CC9"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="795" x2="214" y2="795" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="800" x2="211" y2="800" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="207" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Tickets</text>
    </g>
    
    <g id="profile-tab">
      <circle cx="288" cy="795" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <ellipse cx="288" cy="807" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="288" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Profile</text>
    </g>
    
    <g id="more-tab">
      <circle cx="350" cy="795" r="2" fill="#000000"/>
      <circle cx="350" cy="802" r="2" fill="#000000"/>
      <circle cx="350" cy="809" r="2" fill="#000000"/>
      <text x="350" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">More</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
